summary.zh: 检验有效向内对流是否能解释部分峰化。
summary.en: Test whether effective inward convection could explain part of the peaking.

details.en: V < 0 denotes inward convection under an outward-positive convention. This hypothesis is not verified for any specific discharge and is not a universal mechanism.

label.zh: 无束供粒仍有密度峰化

summary.zh: C-Mod 的低碰撞性 ICRF H 模在无 NBI 条件下仍出现峰化。
summary.en: Low-collisionality ICRF C-Mod H-modes exhibit peaking without NBI.

details.zh: 原文报告的现象限制仅束流解释；不将无 NBI 改写成零总粒子源。全局峰化因子不同于指定半径的 R/Lne，坐标定义仍需核对。
details.en: The reported phenomenon constrains beam-only explanations; absence of NBI is not zero total particle source. Global peaking differs from pointwise R/Lne, and coordinate definitions still require checking.

statement.zh: 加入 C-Mod 后，碰撞性经验比较比仅用 Greenwald 分数更好地连接这些装置；仅 ICRF 子集进一步增强该经验支持。
statement.en: Adding C-Mod makes the collisionality comparison connect these devices better than Greenwald fraction alone; the ICRF-only subset strengthens that empirical support.

conditions.zh: C-Mod 准稳态 ELMy H 模，51 次放电，仅 ICRF、无 NBI；有效碰撞性 0.35—8，电子和离子温度接近；与 AUG/JET 比较。
conditions.en: 51 C-Mod quasi-steady ELMy H-mode shots, ICRF heating without NBI; effective collisionality 0.35–8 and near-equilibrated electron/ion temperatures; comparison with AUG/JET.

statement.zh: C-Mod 未参与原 AUG/JET 定标拟合；图 4 将其与既有经验律作装置外比较，构成新增预测检验。
statement.en: C-Mod was not used in the original AUG/JET fit; Fig. 4 compares it with the existing law and provides an additional external-device prediction test.

statement.zh: 拟合误差相近的竞争模型给出不同 ITER 峰化外推，不能以样本内误差确认跨装置预测。
statement.en: Competing models with similar fitting errors give different ITER peaking projections; in-sample error alone does not establish cross-device prediction.

conditions.zh: AUG/JET ELMy H 模联合数据库，22 页 Max Planck 机构作者稿；固定观测量与代理量定义。

summary.zh: 图 2—4 提供预测变量比较与既有经验律的新增装置检验。
summary.en: Figures 2–4 compare predictors and test an existing empirical law on an added device.

details.zh: C-Mod 没有参加原 AUG/JET 拟合，因而不是简单增加拟合样本。图 2—3 改变协变量覆盖，图 4 检验既有预测。此处引用原图注和正文，未数字化散点，也未复现误差或因果效应。
details.en: C-Mod did not participate in the original AUG/JET fit. Figures 2–3 change predictor coverage, and Fig. 4 tests the existing prediction. Citations use original captions and prose; plotted points, errors and causal effects have not been independently reproduced.

statement.zh: 联合数据库保留碰撞性与 Greenwald 分数的强相关；作者未排除 Greenwald 竞争定标。
statement.en: The combined database retains strong collisionality/Greenwald covariance; the authors do not exclude the competing Greenwald scaling.

summary.zh: 从相关的 AUG/JET 比较推进到 C-Mod 检验；微观通量机制尚未证明。
summary.en: The correlated AUG/JET comparison advances to a C-Mod test; microscopic flux mechanisms remain unproved.

details.zh: Angioni 记录原有碰撞性与 Greenwald 歧义；Greenwald 的新增装置覆盖更支持碰撞性经验定标。结论限定于所研究 H 模、观测量与代理量约定，不能声称跨所有装置普适或直接因果。
details.en: Angioni documents the predictor ambiguity, while Greenwald supplies discriminating device coverage. The update is bounded by the studied H-modes, observables and proxy conventions; it does not establish universal transfer or direct causation.

statement.zh: 束流贡献估计依赖近似恒定热与粒子扩散比；该模型内束供粒不能解释全部峰化变化。
statement.en: Beam-source attribution assumes an approximately constant heat/particle diffusivity ratio; within these models beam fuelling cannot explain all peaking variation.

summary.zh: 经验定标与稳态峰化不足以唯一确定扩散、对流和有限源的作用。
summary.en: Empirical scaling and steady peaking do not uniquely identify diffusion, convection and finite-source contributions.

details.zh: 需建立有限源粒子平衡、诊断与坐标匹配以及可识别的输运闭合。源贡献受输运比假设影响，原刊未提供完整源账本或独立通量拆分。不能由全局峰化直接推出局部梯度或电子/离子梯度偏导响应。
details.en: Finite-source balance, diagnostic/coordinate matching and identifiable transport closure are required. Source attribution depends on diffusivity-ratio assumptions; the letter provides no complete source inventory or independently resolved flux split. Global peaking does not establish local gradients or electron/ion gradient partial responses.

summary.zh: 核对观测定义，开展留一装置预测与能区分通量闭合的受控扫描。
summary.en: Audit observable definitions, test held-out devices and design controlled scans that distinguish flux closures.

details.zh: 计划取得合法放电级数据、诊断协方差、源剖面和瞬态；冻结竞争模型、检查条件参数覆盖、按放电聚类留一装置检验，并预先规定否定判据。该计划尚未开展，不表示模型已复现或机制已验证。
details.en: Proposed work requires lawful shot-level data, diagnostic covariance, source profiles and transients. Freeze competing models, check conditional support, cluster by shot, test held-out devices and prespecify rejection criteria. This plan has not been performed and does not certify reproduction or mechanism validation.

conditions.zh: AUG/JET ELMy H 模联合数据库，22 页 Max Planck 机构作者稿；固定观测量与代理量定义。
conditions.en: Combined AUG/JET ELMy H-mode database, identified 22-page Max Planck author manuscript; fixed observable and proxy definitions.

statement.zh: C-Mod 未参与原 AUG/JET 定标拟合；图 4 将其与既有经验律作装置外比较，构成新增预测检验。
statement.en: C-Mod was not used in the original AUG/JET fit; Fig. 4 compares it with the existing law and provides an additional external-device prediction test.

conditions.zh: C-Mod 准稳态 ELMy H 模，51 次放电，仅 ICRF、无 NBI；有效碰撞性 0.35—8，电子和离子温度接近；与 AUG/JET 比较。
conditions.en: 51 C-Mod quasi-steady ELMy H-mode shots, ICRF heating without NBI; effective collisionality 0.35–8 and near-equilibrated electron/ion temperatures; comparison with AUG/JET.

locator.en: Journal L28, §2, Eq. (1); L29, Fig. 4; G07-C04

rationale.zh: 计划通过诊断匹配、装置外预测和瞬态源扫描约束未识别结构；尚未执行。
rationale.en: Diagnostic matching, external-device prediction and transient source scans are proposed to constrain unidentified structure; not performed.

statement.zh: 加入 C-Mod 后，碰撞性经验比较比仅用 Greenwald 分数更好地连接这些装置；仅 ICRF 子集进一步增强该经验支持。
statement.en: Adding C-Mod makes the collisionality comparison connect these devices better than Greenwald fraction alone; the ICRF-only subset strengthens that empirical support.

conditions.zh: C-Mod 准稳态 ELMy H 模，51 次放电，仅 ICRF、无 NBI；有效碰撞性 0.35—8，电子和离子温度接近；与 AUG/JET 比较。
conditions.en: 51 C-Mod quasi-steady ELMy H-mode shots, ICRF heating without NBI; effective collisionality 0.35–8 and near-equilibrated electron/ion temperatures; comparison with AUG/JET.

statement.zh: 拟合误差相近的竞争模型给出不同 ITER 峰化外推，不能以样本内误差确认跨装置预测。
statement.en: Competing models with similar fitting errors give different ITER peaking projections; in-sample error alone does not establish cross-device prediction.

conditions.zh: AUG/JET ELMy H 模联合数据库，22 页 Max Planck 机构作者稿；固定观测量与代理量定义。
conditions.en: Combined AUG/JET ELMy H-mode database, identified 22-page Max Planck author manuscript; fixed observable and proxy definitions.

rationale.zh: 留一装置与条件覆盖分析针对经验预测变量判别，并另行设计机制检验。
rationale.en: Held-out-device and conditional-support analyses target predictor discrimination, with separate mechanism tests.

statement.zh: 束流贡献估计依赖近似恒定热与粒子扩散比；该模型内束供粒不能解释全部峰化变化。
statement.en: Beam-source attribution assumes an approximately constant heat/particle diffusivity ratio; within these models beam fuelling cannot explain all peaking variation.

conditions.zh: AUG/JET ELMy H 模联合数据库，22 页 Max Planck 机构作者稿；固定观测量与代理量定义。
conditions.en: Combined AUG/JET ELMy H-mode database, identified 22-page Max Planck author manuscript; fixed observable and proxy definitions.

statement.zh: 无 NBI 的 C-Mod 低碰撞性 ICRF H 模仍有密度峰化，说明束流核心供粒不是这些观测的必要条件。
statement.en: Low-collisionality ICRF C-Mod H-modes exhibit density peaking without NBI, so beam core fuelling is not necessary for these observations.

conditions.zh: C-Mod 准稳态 ELMy H 模，51 次放电，仅 ICRF、无 NBI；有效碰撞性 0.35—8，电子和离子温度接近；与 AUG/JET 比较。
conditions.en: 51 C-Mod quasi-steady ELMy H-mode shots, ICRF heating without NBI; effective collisionality 0.35–8 and near-equilibrated electron/ion temperatures; comparison with AUG/JET.

rationale.zh: 认识更新必须保留输运比、有限源及观测量的适用限制。
rationale.en: The knowledge update retains diffusivity-ratio, finite-source and observable limitations.
